topic: Scaling operations and Australia project setup
summary_markdown:
The discussion highlighted significant operational strain across multiple departments (IT, data, sales) due to an increasing volume and diversity of projects. Scaling productivity was identified as a major challenge, exacerbated by the time required for new team members to become fully productive.

To address knowledge gaps and improve efficiency, plans were made to create scripts and procedure lists for routine data tasks. Furthermore, specific steps were defined for setting up the Australia project demo account:
*   A dedicated demo account will be added to production.
*   The process involves copying and modifying Brazil data for approximately 20 sensors/locations.
*   This setup requires selecting facilities and locations to ensure the demo is realistic.
decisions: A demo account will be added to production.
Brazil data for about 20 sensors will be copied, modified, and access provided for the Australia project.
action_items: Someone needs to select facilities/locations for the demo account setup.
Create scripts and procedure lists for routine data tasks to improve efficiency.
